title: Jhandewalan Temple
tagline: Jhandewalan Temple — Sacred Shakti Peeth & Iconic 108-Foot Hanuman Landmark

heroImage.alt: Jhandewalan Temple iconic heritage in Delhi, India

overview.short: Jhandewalan Temple in Central Delhi is an ancient sanctuary dedicated to Maa Aadi Shakti, famous for its historic prayer flags and the iconic 108-foot Hanuman colossus.
overview.description: Named after the prayer flags (jhandas) hoisted by Mughal-era merchant Badri Bhagat, Jhandewalan Devi Mandir is one of Delhi’s most revered historic Shakti temples. Located on Desh Bandhu Gupta Road near Karol Bagh, the area is also globally recognized for the towering 108-foot Sankat Mochan Hanuman statue through which metro trains dramatically pass, Ajmal Khan Park, and bustling heritage trading bazaars.
overview.about: A vital spiritual hub in the heart of Delhi, Jhandewalan combines centuries of devotional heritage with easy access to New Delhi Railway Station, Connaught Place, and the lush forests of the Central Ridge.

howToReach.roadNote: Directly served by Jhandewalan Metro Station (Blue Line). Abundant e-rickshaws, autos, and buses connect to Karol Bagh and Connaught Place.

topPlaces.name: Jhandewalan Devi Mandir
topPlaces.description: Ancient underground sanctum where the idol of Maa Jhandewali was excavated by Badri Bhagat in the 18th century.

image.alt: Jhandewalan Devi Mandir in Jhandewalan Temple, Delhi

topPlaces.name: 108-Foot Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple
topPlaces.description: World-famous 108ft standing statue of Lord Hanuman flanked by dramatic mechanical temple gates and a subterranean cave shrine.

image.alt: 108-Foot Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple in Jhandewalan Temple, Delhi

topPlaces.name: Ajmal Khan Park & Musical Fountains
topPlaces.description: Expansive 24-acre heritage garden named after freedom fighter Hakim Ajmal Khan with manicured lawns and seasonal blooms.

image.alt: Ajmal Khan Park & Musical Fountains in Jhandewalan Temple, Delhi

topPlaces.name: Laxminarayan Temple (Birla Mandir)
topPlaces.description: Iconic red sandstone and marble temple inaugurated by Mahatma Gandhi on the condition of casteless entry for all.

image.alt: Laxminarayan Temple (Birla Mandir) in Jhandewalan Temple, Delhi

topPlaces.name: Qadam Sharif Fortress & Dargah
topPlaces.description: Historic 14th-century Tughlaq-era fortress and mausoleum preserving a sacred stone slab with the Prophet’s footprint.

image.alt: Qadam Sharif Fortress & Dargah in Jhandewalan Temple, Delhi

topPlaces.name: Karol Bagh Market & Gaffar Bazaar
topPlaces.description: One of Delhi’s oldest and most vibrant retail avenues celebrated for traditional bridal attire, jewellery, and street food.

image.alt: Karol Bagh Market & Gaffar Bazaar in Jhandewalan Temple, Delhi

topPlaces.name: Paharganj Heritage Quarter & Bazaars
topPlaces.description: Historic imperial Mughal suburb outside Ajmeri Gate renowned for colorful leather goods, incense shops, and international cafes.

image.alt: Paharganj Heritage Quarter & Bazaars in Jhandewalan Temple, Delhi

topPlaces.name: Central Ridge Forest & Buddha Jayanti Park
topPlaces.description: Pristine green woodland preserve in central Delhi with scenic canopy trails, bird watching, and the serene Buddha Jayanti garden.

image.alt: Central Ridge Forest & Buddha Jayanti Park in Jhandewalan Temple, Delhi

faq.q: Which metro station is closest to Jhandewalan Temple?
faq.a: Jhandewalan Metro Station on the Blue Line is right next to the 108ft Hanuman Statue and 300 metres from Jhandewalan Temple.

faq.q: Can we take photographs at the 108ft Hanuman Temple?
faq.a: Photography is allowed outside to capture the iconic statue with the metro passing in front; inside sanctum photography is restricted.
